entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello. I... I think I need to return something? I'm a bit overwhelmed. I bought these cycling shoes and I'm just so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly help you with that. Not a problem at all. Do you have your order number handy?
Um, I think so... one moment. Okay, it's VF-8675309.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Pedal cycling shoes, delivered about 84 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

I really don't know. I tried to attach the cleats and it was so difficult. When I finally managed to try them, they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. It's all just too much. Can't you just help me?
I'm very sorry to hear about the blisters and the trouble with the cleats. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me check the return eligibility for you right now.
Okay, I've reviewed your order and our policy. Since you received the shoes 84 days ago, you are still well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, really? So it's not too late? I can get a refund? I was so worried I was stuck with them.

Yes, absolutely. You are eligible for a full refund. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'm sending a pre-paid return shipping label to the email address on file. Just package the cycling shoes up, and you'll be all set.
Wow, thank you so much, Sarah. That is such a relief. You've made this very easy.
You're very welcome! We'll process your refund as soon as we receive the item. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for your help!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
